name: Tsukikage (月影, "Moon-shadow")
concept: A Mystic-class Frame, quiet and steady where Ren himself is quiet and steady with his body instead — its Eldritch Lance reads at Frame scale as a beam of raw psychic force from the dark between stars, and its Transfer Vitality is the one place in this whole roster where 'a spell is a kilometre-wide effect' means healing, not hurting.

classFeatures.name: Vitality Network
classFeatures.description: Your soul supports a network of energy that connects and heals those in your bond. Grants Transfer Vitality.

notes: DRAFT — proposed 2026-08-22 at Ingram's direct request, open to full revision. Reuses the SAME real, pack-extracted content already proven in tools/battle-simulator/data/combatants.mjs's makeMysticFrame() (design doc §14k) — Eldritch Lance and Transfer Vitality are the actual Player Core text of a real level-1 Mystic pregen's cantrip and class feature (tools/pack-extractor/, gamesystems/sf2e/packs/paizo-pregens), scaled to level 12 via real rules (cantrips auto-heighten to half level rounded up; Transfer Vitality's own printed +10-per-5-levels text). AC/HP updated from that test fixture's ad hoc approximation (28/150) to the real GM Core Low-tier numbers (30/160) now that this project has those exact tables pulled — the battle-simulator test fixture itself is left untouched (it's tested, working infrastructure serving a different purpose: a stress-test combatant, not this campaign's actual roster). This is the one Frame in this batch whose combat kit is already end-to-end proven in the battle simulator, not just documented.
